people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.
translations.bsb: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
